description: Verifier: record a result and evidence for acceptance criteria. test and command criteria need a local key, review criteria a reviewer key. A criterion passes only on positive evidence: a skipped or unmatched test is missing.

head_sha.description: The commit these results are for. Rejected unless it is the run's head_sha

evidence.description: Test id and outcome, command and exit code, or a rationale citing files or lines

verifier_key.description: Your verifier key (MINDPM_VERIFIER_KEY or MINDPM_REVIEWER_KEY). Never pass it to an executor
